name: 李畅
title: 多智能体仿真，强化学习，计算机图形学，群体智能
titleEn: Multi-agent simulation, reinforcement learning, computer graphics, swarm intelligence
bio: 多智能体仿真、强化学习、计算机图形学与群体智能的交叉研究，旨在理解、建模并重现复杂群体的交互与涌现规律，为大规模智能体在虚拟与现实环境中的自主决策、协同演化和可信仿真提供基础支撑。
bioEn: Research at the intersection of multi-agent simulation, reinforcement learning, computer graphics, and swarm intelligence is crucial for understanding, modeling, and reproducing complex group interactions and emergent behaviors, while providing a foundation for autonomous decision-making, coordinated evolution, and realistic large-scale simulation of intelligent agents in both virtual and real-world environments.
description: 李畅的个人学术主页：研究、论文、项目、写作和随笔。
descriptionEn: LiChang’s personal academic website: research, publications, projects, writing, and reflections.
